title: Implement Selection Sort
description: Given `N` and an array of `N` integers, sort the array in ascending order using Selection Sort and print the sorted elements separated by spaces.
instructions: For each position `i`, find the index `minIdx` of the smallest element in `arr[i..N-1]`.
Print the sorted array separated by spaces.
hints: Initialize `minIdx = i` at the start of each outer iteration.
Inner loop scans `j = i + 1` to `n - 1` updating `minIdx` when `arr[j] < arr[minIdx]`.
Swap `arr[i]` and `arr[minIdx]` after the inner loop.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input().strip())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Implement selection sort and print
